Subject: Post-discovery: initial 30-min demo — next steps & availability

Hi Sam and Aisha,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the context on NorthStar's priorities (real-time risk scoring, model observability, and tight SLOs on inference latency). Quick recap from our side:

- Primary use case: low-latency inference for scoring at decisioning (50–200ms P95 target)
- Expected Q3 pilot: 5–10M tokens/day, mixed short/long sequences, preferring open-model variants
- Security requirements: VPC/private deployment for PII data + SOC 2 evidence

Next step: a focused 30-minute product demo to walk through the runtime, batching behavior, and our routing/fallback story. Would love to include your Platform/ML engineering stakeholders so we can cover technical constraints. Please pick one of these 30-minute slots (all times PT):

Option A — Tue Mar 10 — 10:00–10:30 PT (1:00–1:30 ET)
Option B — Wed Mar 11 — 11:00–11:30 PT (2:00–2:30 ET)
Option C — Thu Mar 12 — 09:00–09:30 PT (12:00–12:30 ET)

If none of those work, reply with 2–3 alternatives and I’ll align calendars. Also let me know which teammates you want on the call (recommended: Head of ML, Platform Eng). I’ve attached the short discovery notes and a tentative 30-minute demo agenda.

Shared links: calendar (if easier) — https://calendly.com/vanessa-ortiz/redwood-demo-30min
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/contacts/NSB-67890

Attachments: Discovery-Notes-2026-03-09.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
